display_long_description:
**StarGateVR** puts astronomical data in your hands — query archives, visualize in 3D, and collaborate in VR on Meta Quest.

**Live archive access:**
• Query Gaia DR3 directly — describe a dataset and retrieve it live
• Cross-match with multi-wavelength archives in a single command
• Integrated: Gaia DR3 · eROSITA · GALEX · 2MASS · WISE · SIMBAD · MOCA

**3D visualization:**
• Map any parameters to spatial axes
• Switch between physical coordinates, HR diagrams, and custom parameter spaces
• Color and shade points by additional variables

**Multi-dimensional gating:**
• Select and filter data interactively in 3D space
• Isolate populations across parameter dimensions

**Collaboration:**
• Shared VR sessions with voice communication
• Enriched datasets sync across all participants

**Your data, your way:**
• Import CSV, VOTable, or FITS formats
• Export findings for follow-up in TOPCAT, astropy, or your own pipelines

**AI Assistant (Early Access):**
• Voice-controlled — query datasets and archives by speaking naturally
• Requires internet and Meta sign-in. Improves automatically, no update required.
• In development. Feedback welcome: support@immsci.com

Designed for researchers, educators, and advanced hobbyists.

Looking for an educational introduction to 3D star mapping? Try **ConstellationsVR**, our entry-level experience with an AI astronomy guide for STEM learners.

Note: StarGateVR is a scientific research tool by Immersive Science LLC. It is not affiliated with the Stargate media franchise or the Stargate AI initiative.
